name: weather_geocode_place
description: Resolve a place name to coordinates using the Open-Meteo geocoding API. Returns a 'results' array of candidate places, each with name, country, admin1 (state or region), latitude, longitude, timezone and population. IMPORTANT: when nothing matches, the response contains no 'results' key at all rather than an empty array. Call this before requesting a forecast, and pick the candidate whose country and region best match the user's intent.

place.description: City, town or region name to look up, for example 'Bengaluru' or 'New York'. Do not include the country.
